description: Spousal consent is commonly requested for surgical and obstetric procedures as a matter of practice rather than law - which means a woman's operation can wait for a man to be located.
energy_note: The theatre waiting while somebody phones your husband.

aspect: Marital rape is outside the definition
description: The VAPP Act expanded the definition of rape significantly but is described in the literature as not covering spousal rape, which leaves the commonest context outside the offence.
energy_note: The most likely place for it is the one place it is not the offence.

aspect: And the remedy is the family, which is the interested party
description: Where the offence is not prosecutable and the police route in POL-003 is closed, the mechanism is family mediation - conducted by the people with the strongest interest in the marriage continuing.
energy_note: Judged by the people who want it settled.

description: She is thirty-eight, has capacity, and is signing for her own hysterectomy. The ward asks, pleasantly, whether her husband is coming, and waits. Nobody says it is required. Nobody proceeds either.
energy_note: Nobody said she needed him. Nobody started without him.
